scope: Synthetic negative-control experiment, locally specified before running; not a real-world effect-size study.
labels: Independent random binary labels; features are independent standard-normal noise.
bad: SelectKBest(f_classif, k=50).fit_transform on all X and y before train_test_split.
fixed: Same raw train/test row assignments; SelectKBest inside a Pipeline fitted on training only.
metric: Test accuracy; report every data seed, mean and paired differences.
claim_boundary: Shows that a supported code pattern can produce inflated evaluation scores on deliberately unlearnable noise. Does not quantify prevalence, real-world impact or model-quality improvement.
